text:
Maya: thinking of adding a staged_apply flow to the runtime-config API so teams can roll settings to a percentage with telemetry gates and automatic rollback :thinking_face:
Devin: solid idea. question: how do we prevent tiny cohorts from accidentally hitting expensive routing pools and blowing quota?
Sanjay: don't pre-reserve capacity. instead run shadow routing + sampled real traffic. pick sample cohorts across tenant size / latency buckets to reduce bias.
Priya: console idea: a live-preview overlay that shows cohort distribution, projected QPS delta, and a mini-trace sample. let users tweak cohort_pct and evaluation_window before committing.
Alex: API concerns: we need an apply_id and optimistic merge on the config store. otherwise two teams staging changes could collide. also idempotency token for retries.
Maya: agreed on apply_id and idempotency. plus a dry_run mode that emits all eval telemetry but leaves routing unchanged.
Devin: sketch for staged_apply schema (informal): cohort_pct, metrics[], eval_window_mins, dry_run boolean, auto_rollback thresholds. API returns apply_id + simulator_token.
Sanjay: sampling keys = hash(tenant_id + request_path) with controllable seed so cohorts are reproducible for replay.
Priya: UX: when dry_run=true, overlay a heatmap of affected routes and a safety_score derived from metric variance and sample size. add a "preview replay" button to run historical-sim.
Alex: quota interplay: if cohort shifts traffic to a GPU-backed pool, signal quota service. add optional auto-throttle to slow cohort growth if pool_util > 0.75.
Maya: add a backpressure hook: pause growth, notify owners, and record event in audit trail.
Devin: metrics set: start small — error_rate, latency_p50, cost_per_1k_tokens. rollback if error_rate delta > 1.5x baseline or latency_p50 up >20%.
Sanjay: sampling for traces should be limited. default: 10% of cohort for detailed traces, 100% for scalar counters to keep SLOs accurate without exploding trace storage.
Priya: console controls: start/pause, growth schedule (e.g., 5 -> 20 -> 100 over N hours), manual override, immediate rollback, and historical replay.
Alex: security: simulator tokens and dry_run outputs must be ACL-scoped and TTL'd. don't expose raw logs.
Maya: rough API example (pseudo):
```http
POST /api/v1/configs/:id/apply
{
  "staged_apply": {
    "cohort_pct": 5,
    "metrics": ["error_rate","latency_p50","cost_per_1k_tokens"],
    "evaluation_window_mins": 30,
    "dry_run": false,
    "auto_rollback": {"error_rate": 0.02}
  }
}
```
Devin: who decides rollback? central controller with owner notification seems easiest operationally. must surface decision rationale (explain log).
Sanjay: central controller ok as long as we keep a decision log and allow manual override. add a "why rolled back" message + metrics snapshot.
Priya: UX should show predicted roll-forward timeline and one-click rollback. persist audit entries for compliance.
ops-bot: created ticket ROLL-4321 for staged_apply + assigned to @Maya and @Sanjay :white_check_mark:
Maya: I'll draft RFC tomorrow. volunteers to review telemetry sampling and quota-backpressure hooks?
Devin: I'll own quota integration.
Sanjay: telemetry + rollback thresholds.
Priya: I'll mock console screens and post in #design.
Alex: I'll implement apply_id/merge contract and add idempotency tests.
Maya: thanks all — aim for RFC next week. :thumbsup:
